topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The rain's been falling like it's trying to wash away more than the grime. Got a call from someone in a hurry, voice tight, said their flight got pushed back, missed some kind of meeting that meant a lot. Told them I could try to smooth things over, throw my weight around a little, but there's only so much even I can do against an angry sky. Maybe I should’ve left well enough alone, but something in their voice, the way it cracked at the end—made me think of all the times I wished there was someone who could make things right when they went sideways. So I'm on it, making calls, trying to work some angles, hoping it's not too late. Hope's a funny thing, makes you do things you wouldn’t otherwise.
